profile.org_note: The Builder 100 'Empire Homes' (rank 61) is the former Empire Communities of Vaughan, Ontario, rebranded in July 2025 (a search-result summary of Builder's firm profile shows Vaughan, Ontario and the Guizzetti brothers as CEOs; the page itself is bot-blocked and was not opened). Corporate office is in Vaughan, Ontario, Canada, with a U.S. corporate office at 5775 Glenridge Drive, Atlanta, GA. It is one operating company of Willowdale Asset Management, alongside Precedent Land Company (land development, the former land division), Rooftop Capital (financing and lot banking), Empire Rental Living and ERTH360. Two COOs (USA and Canada) sit under the co-CEOs; U.S. regional and division presidents sit under the U.S. COO. Land and capital decisions are made at the Willowdale level: the co-CEOs, Patryk Dawidowski (SVP, Investment Management) and Andrew Hamilton (SVP of Finance), with Precedent's regional presidents and the homebuilding regional presidents sourcing deals locally.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name, e.g. rjurdi@empirecommunities.com (seen November 2024, before the rebrand; the company now publishes mailboxes at empirehomes.com, so the current personal-address domain is not confirmed)
profile.summary: Canadian-owned private builder (founders Daniel and Andrew Guizzetti) ranked 61 on the 2026 Builder 100, building in the U.S. across Houston, Austin, San Antonio, Atlanta, Chattanooga, Charlotte, Greenville and Colorado Springs, plus a large Ontario low-rise and condo business. It is land-heavy and vertically integrated: the company cites 28,000 to 29,000 future homesites, and its sister company Precedent Land Company develops lots for it and for other builders. The parent also owns Rooftop Capital, which offers lot banking to U.S. builders, so the group is both a possible customer and a small competitor.
